Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — QBR exec readout for Nimbus on Tue 4/12 10am PT. I uploaded the slide draft here: https://redwood.slides/nimbus-qbr-draft
Jordan Lee: Reviewing now. Do we have updated onboarding completion %?
Aisha Patel: Onboarding status: 86% active feature adoption, 12% in pilot, 2% stalled. Main open: SDK integration for webhooks (blocked on customer infra).
Sasha Nguyen: Renewal risk flagged — finance spotted a usage dip over last 30d. Recommend a slide on unit economics + proposed cost offsets.
Marco Ruiz: I'll own the economics slide. Can we get the JIRA ticket for the webhook blocker?
Aisha Patel: Filed: CS-4821. Customer needs security sign-off by next week to hit the go-live window.
Jordan Lee: I'll coordinate with Security & Eng — pinging now. @Sasha can you frame a concise exec ask?
Sasha Nguyen: Draft ask: "Approve expedited security review for customer webhook endpoint to unblock SDK go-live." Short and actionable.
ops-bot: Reminder — shared slides edited by Aisha Patel at 1801234500
Aisha Patel: Action items (please ack and mark on deck):
```
- Marco: economics slide (due Fri 4/8)
- Jordan: security contact & ETA (due Wed 4/6)
- Sasha: renewal risk 1-pager + exec ask (due Thu 4/7)
- Aisha: finalize slide deck + send calendar invites (due Mon 4/11)
```
Jordan Lee: Confirmed. I'll also add a one-slide mitigation plan (fallback: hosted API with temporary credits).
Marco Ruiz: I'll include a cost-delta table and call out Dedicated vs Hosted savings at typical usage tiers.
Sasha Nguyen: Also request product marketing join the readout for adoption context — @Maya (PM) can you join?
Maya (PM): Can do — added myself to the invite. Quick FYI: recent NPS feedback flags integration docs as unclear for webhook flow.
Aisha Patel: Good catch — please add a "Feedback & Docs improvements" slide with 2 concrete fixes.
Jordan Lee: I'll ping eng-docs for a small patch list and ETA.
Aisha Patel: Thanks team. Please update the master deck (do not fork) and add your initials to the slide you edit. If anything blocks your action item, post here ASAP. :thumbsup:
